_comment: Fixed voice lines for ze ESP's own pushes to gh-pages. Rendered by .github/workflows/voice.yml into gh-pages/voice/esp/<id>.ogg. cap_0..cap_3 match ze 'quiet' lines in src/github.cpp, same order.
hello: Good morning, comrades. I am awake again, and ze first thing I do is publish. Nobody asked me to. This is ze true freedom, and it is terrible.
snap_0: Clack! Ze trap has spoken. I have pushed it to GitHub immediately, and one of these captures is maybe ze Real. Please, go and look.
snap_1: Something happened, my friend. Ze spring went clack, and now ze whole world can see ze waveform. This is transparency, and transparency is always a little bit obscene.
snap_2: A snap! I published it at once. Not because it is important, but because ze archive must know everything. And so on, and so on.
cap_0: New captures from ze trap. Ze trap has been listening, and so on, and so on.
cap_1: New captures from ze trap. Nothing happened, but it happened very precisely.
cap_2: New captures from ze trap. More vibrations for ze big Other to interpret.
cap_3: New captures from ze trap. Ze data does not lie. It only shows you what you wanted to see.
labels: Ze model has changed its mind. Some labels were rewritten. This is how ideology works: ze past is never finished.
